QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` nested and flat, then `~/.entropic/...` nested and flat, then `ctypes.util.find_library("rentropic")`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the order of env overrides, then the default user directory, then the system library lookup, and it says nested and flat layouts are tried per root. `find_library` stands in for the system library cache, which is close enough.
